relation_specs.definition: Target is effectively inevitable given the source event.
Target would not have happened without source; source alone need not guarantee target.

layer01.coreference: Group only mentions of the same real-world event.
layer01.recall_policy: FROZEN v1.4 behavior; reuse its validated exact-span inventory when available, otherwise execute the unchanged v1.4 extractor.
layer01.coreference_policy: keep singleton mention endpoints during extraction to avoid destructive under-merging; posthoc maps span to gold cluster
layer01.rescue_policy: after generative extraction, verify a source-only over-complete lexical candidate pool, then perform one final missed-event review
layer01.span_repair: repair only against visible source tokens; no gold IDs/types/relations

layer02.event_input: all frozen v1.4 event mentions; do not delete Layer-1 inventory
layer02.coreference_for_reasoning: conservatively group only clear same-real-world-event mentions; uncertain mentions remain singleton; this does not mutate Layer 1
layer02.candidate_pool: two complementary sparse whole-document directed graph proposals plus a source-only same-sentence causal-cue fallback; no all-local-pair enumeration
layer02.strict_verifier: default REJECT; require document support and the chosen MAVEN definition test (CAUSE sufficiency or PRECONDITION necessity)
layer02.skeptic: independently search for chronology/topic/coreference/restatement/unsupported-goal false positives; edge survives only if skeptic cannot reject it
layer02.direction: semantic causal direction only; never surface mention order

gold_policy: Gold event clusters and causal relations are loaded only after Layer 12.
